data.one_liner: A customizable carousel slider widget with infinite scroll and autoplay support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a carousel slider widget that supports infinite scrolling, autoplay, custom child widgets, and on-demand building. It also includes a controller for manually managing page position.
use_when: You need a horizontally or vertically scrolling carousel or slider in your UI.
You want support for infinite scrolling, custom viewports, and autoplay out of the box.
avoid_when: You require complex custom physics or layouts that go beyond standard carousel options.
strengths: On-demand item builder for memory efficiency.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: The original package this fork is based on, though this fork is actively maintained to support newer Flutter versions.
